subject: ACEBench c1_v2_verified: the ACE request validator on both branches of the C1 v2 capacity gate

incidents.error: PolicyInputError: Targets and privileged request fields are forbidden: ['c2kv_ace_source'], then api_health terminal runner_failed and the whole cell exits

cause: build_acebench_controller binds _validate_ace_request (which parses the receipt-backed c2kv_ace_source) to the single S0 controller reached through base delegation. Since 1b32ffc, build_c1_v2 wraps two S0 branches in CapacityGatedSourceAllocator; base delegation reaches only the incumbent, so the source-allocation branch kept the stock validator, which only allows session_id, decision_key, messages and tools. The first decision where the incumbent raised CapacityInfeasible failed validation in the source branch, and a PolicyInputError is terminal instead of task-local.
change: CapacityGatedSourceAllocator.policy_branches declares (incumbent, source_allocator); build_acebench_controller binds the ACE validator on every S0 leaf found through base and declared branches (static lookup, so __getattr__ delegation cannot hide the gate)
unchanged: Controller graphs without the gate resolve to the same single leaf as before.
The ACE validator still rejects every field other than session_id, decision_key, messages, tools and c2kv_ace_source (targets, gold answers and official task ids are rejected on both branches).

tau2, AppWorld and ToolSandbox use the openai-single-task-v1 source profile, whose runner payload carries only the standard fields; box9 racer_v2_c2kv_c1_v2_verified_b256 steps for them (97, 100, 7) have no such error.
v1, off and bare arms do not build the gate.
after_fix: an ACE decision whose incumbent cannot fit now runs the same source-allocation rescue as BFCL; when neither branch fits it is a task-local CapacityInfeasible

tests.file: experiments/history_system/runtime/benchmarks/memory_runtime/tests/test_acebench_capacity_source_gate.py (18 new; 12 fail on 077559f, the 6 guard tests pass on both)
tests.real_record: the failed box9 c2kv decision's ACE source and committed actions copied verbatim (prompts and observations are stand-ins because the step log does not store them)
tests.suites: benchmarks, runtime memory_runtime and delivery suites have the same failure sets as 54749ff

rerun: every ACEBench c1_v2_verified cell run on 1b32ffc..54749ff (their decisions that reached the source branch failed)
not_covered: ACE regeneration and recovery repack on the source branch are not exercised by the tests
